findings.before: Standard FOLFIRI 00227 dose-level, timed ANC/platelet stop and grade-based toxicity rules had been copied into aflibercept/FOLFIRI; governance even named NCCP 00227.
findings.correction: Removed borrowed dose levels and timed stops. Rebuilt from own Table 2 recurrence/percentage pathways; current ANC<1.5 or platelets<75 holds independently of duration.

findings.before: Grade 4 neutropenia with fever used generic level reductions rather than recurrence-specific component decisions.
findings.correction: First FN/sepsis: irinotecan 15–20% selected by consultant; second additionally 5-FU bolus+infusion 20% while maintaining reduced irinotecan; third consider aflibercept 2 mg/kg/G-CSF. Recovery/current-dose history are never assumed; no numeric range midpoint.
acceptance_case_families: active FN hold dominates future change

findings.before: Severe renal dosing selected a numeric amount from a range and did not expose the renal-exclusion conflict.
findings.correction: Table 1 CrCl<10/dialysis 50–66% starting irinotecan range requires consultant choice; page 2 renal-impairment exclusion conflicts with the renal dosing table. Block numeric fallback. A renal impairment flag exposes the broader eligibility conflict.

findings.before: Strict bilirubin/AST boundaries and initial-versus-current dose history were insufficiently separated.
findings.correction: Irinotecan bilirubin>3 ULN contraindicated. FU bilirubin>85 OR AST>180 contraindicated; exact 85/180 unresolved. Both values needed for full-dose band. Moderate/severe initial reductions remain consultant decisions reconciled with absolute contraindications and dose history.

findings.before: Proteinuria and hypertension lacked source-specific recurrence/recovery and component-specific vascular stops.
findings.correction: Aflibercept holds at protein≥2 g/24 h (not bevacizumab threshold); second occurrence requires recovery<2 and permanent 2 mg/kg reduction. Hypertension recurrent significant/severe requires control and 2 mg/kg. Persistent uncontrolled HTN/crisis, severe bleed, GI perforation/fistula, ATE, grade 4 VTE, nephrotic/TMA, intervention-requiring wound healing and PRES stop aflibercept only.

findings.before: Severe diarrhoea/stomatitis followed generic borrowed level/time algorithms.
findings.correction: First severe diarrhoea irinotecan 15–20%; second add FU 20%; severe persistence despite both reductions stops FOLFIRI, not automatically aflibercept. Severe stomatitis/PPE FU 20%. Source term severe is explicit; current/recovery and actual dose history required; no automatic level-based substitution.

findings.before: Infusion severity and elective-surgery timing were not distinct.
findings.correction: Mild/moderate aflibercept reaction suspends infusion until resolved; severe reaction stops whole combination. Suspend aflibercept at least 4 weeks before elective surgery; intervention-requiring wound complication follows permanent stop.

findings.before: Protocol supportive-care map incorrectly labelled aflibercept/FOLFIRI low emetogenic risk; schedule drug ordering insufficiently distinguished.
findings.correction: Corrected to moderate due irinotecan. Aflibercept first 60 min, irinotecan 90 min/FA 2 h, thenFUbolus and 46 h pump, q 14 d. Source atropine, delayed-diarrhoea and bolus ice-chip context preserved.

findings.before: Five OF 590 organ rules imported bilirubin 85/AST 180 cutoffs and one-third/half dose reductions from other FU regimens.
findings.correction: Replaced with current v 2 Table 3: renal/dialysis no adjustment expected; mild/moderate hepatic without renal impairment no adjustment expected; severe hepatic not recommended. Combined renal/hepatic impairment or unresolved renal status requires review; no imported absolute cutoffs.

FUbolus 400→320→240→stop; infusion 2400→2000→1600→stop; folinic 400 until associated bolus omitted. Each current component level required; nonstandard actual doses review. Further reduction below−2 explicitly stops the exhausted component, including associated folinic acid for bolus.

findings.before: Generic blood-count rules omitted source duration, nadir and distinct platelet maintenance behaviour.
findings.correction: ANC<1 hold, persistent at 2 weeks stop; lowestANC<1 reduces 1 level after recovery within 2 weeks. Platelet<75 hold; ALL nadir bands maintain dose; persistent at 4 weeks stop. Two-to-four-week source gap requires review. Counts/recovery/time/history missing blocks calculated restart.

findings.before: Generic toxicity grade rules did not distinguish source definitions, highest grade, current recovery or required reductions.
findings.correction: Current≥G 2 diarrhoea/stomatitis independently holds; persistent 2 weeks stops FU pathway. Recovered diarrhoeaG 3/4 and stomatitisG 3 reduce 1 level; stomatitisG 4 reduces 2. Table 6 older source symptom grades are explicitly labelled and preserved, not silently rewritten as CTCAE 5. Missing recovery/timing/source-grade/current-dose context blocks numeric restart.

findings.before: Generic proteinuria grade failed source dipstick/concentration/24-hour distinctions and exact 2 g threshold.
findings.correction: Dipstick 2+/3+ or protein≥1 g/L permits scheduled administration from this domain and collection within 3 days before next dose; dipstick 4+holds;24 h≤2 meets domain,>2–4 holds,>4 stops. More restrictive concurrent results govern; no bevacizumab reduction.

findings.before: Generic numeric BP and mixed bleed/thrombosis/fistula fields implied broader hold/stop actions than source supports.
findings.correction: Explicit uncontrolled/symptomatic day 1 hypertension holds;G 2–3 treat/consider interruption;G 4/persistentG 3 stops. Numeric>150/100 contextual persistence/treatment definition and AND/OR ambiguity are exposed. TE/grade 4 fistula,GIperforation,G 4 thrombosis,≥G 3 bleed stop bev only. Combined legacy fields request specificity.

findings.before: Unlicensed Irish bevacizumab regimen status and whole-strategy trial limitations were not explicit.
findings.correction: Baseline review checks information/consent/local governance. NCCP source-cited study is an induction-maintenance-reintroduction strategy; no isolated 00791 comparative survival number is assigned. Patient and root KB agents notified; primary trial evidence provided.
